Move with the left stick or the keyboard, or walk to the cursor holding the middle mouse button. Tap {run} to start or stop running (it stops by itself when you stand still); hold {run} to light or put out the torch, you need it at night and in the caves: it lights the way you face. {jump} jumps: you climb onto higher ground and enemy strikes pass under you. Dodge while running to slide.

Press {attack} to strike with the sword: the strike lands right away. Quick strikes form a combo (3 at first), each one stronger than the last; hold {attack} to keep attacking. {heavy_attack} is the power strike, wide and very strong: it ends the combo with a bonus. Hold it to charge it up to double damage (it uses mana) and to chain more power strikes.

Hold {parry} to parry with the sword across your body: you block the strikes coming from the front, arrows and bolts included, but it drains stamina. A perfect parry, started right before the hit, stuns the enemy and for 4 seconds doubles your damage and speeds up your attacks. The parry is instant: it cancels whatever you are doing.

{dodge} dodges: a roll on the ground, a dash in mid-air. For an instant you can't be hit and you can steer; press it again to chain more dodges (upgrades add more). Parrying, dodging and jumping cancel any action at once, even a strike halfway through. Jumps and dodges combine: jump, dash in the air and strike from above with {attack}.

The red bar in the top-left panel is Frenzy. It grows with every sword hit that lands, even when the enemy blocks it with his guard; power strikes and ground attacks fill it faster. If you stop attacking for 4 seconds it slowly drains: stay in the fight! When it is full the bar pulses, {parry} + {attack} appears on it and a red ring surrounds the goblin.

With a full Frenzy bar press {parry} and {attack} together (on touch screens, the two buttons at once). Time stops: the enemies freeze, the world goes dark, the goblin roars in a red glow and the camera zooms in. Then he teleports next to the nearest enemy and strikes in a flurry; when it falls he moves on to the next one. Up to 10 hits (+2 with every "Frenzy strikes" upgrade); with no enemies in reach the flurry ends early. You can't be hit during the attack; at the end Frenzy drops to zero.

The green bar is your stamina: attacking, dodging, jumping, parrying and running drain it, and it recovers by itself as soon as you stop. When it's empty you can't attack or dodge, and a parry can break your guard. Your potions are in the bar at the bottom: health {potion}, mana {mana_potion}, stamina {stamina_potion}. Drinking takes a moment: enemies rush in to punish you.

{spell} casts a fireball that chases the nearest enemy in sight: it costs mana (the blue bar), which does not come back by itself: drink mana potions. {shield} raises a magic bubble that absorbs one hit from any direction (30-second recharge). In mid-air, with a Cataclysm rune in your belt, {heavy_attack} smashes it on the ground: the blast kills the enemies around and takes a big chunk out of the boss.

Every enemy blow costs you one heart (two from the boss): a few mistakes and you're down. Before striking enemies glow red and pull back their weapon: that's the moment to parry or dodge. No more than two attack at once, the others circle around. Sometimes they raise their guard: hit them from the side or from behind. Their blows and arrows hurt the other monsters too. You lock on to the nearest enemy in sight by yourself ({lock_on} keeps the lock); it gets a red ring and your strikes and fireballs go its way.

Walk up to chests, merchants, totems and caves and press {interact} when the prompt appears. Chests drop gold and items: swords, armor, boots, amulets, rings and spell books. {inventory} opens the inventory (the game pauses): equip your gear, read the books, sort with {inventory_sort}. Merchants buy what you don't use and sell potions, Cataclysm runes and rare gear.

The lands have no borders. The minimap in the top-right corner shows enemies, chests, totems, merchants and caves; {map} opens the full map. At night you need the torch. Hold {focus} for focus mode: the world dims and only the goblin and the things to pick up keep their colors. Jump to climb the hills and ramps.

Cave entrances open in the mountain walls: go in with {interact}. Down there it's dark and the enemies get tougher level after level: on every level look for the stairs. On the last one the Cave Guardian waits in his arena: he summons help and strikes from afar. Beat him for gold, a Cataclysm rune and gear you won't find anywhere else.

Interact with a totem for a 30-second challenge in waves: survive it for experience and a potion. Every defeated enemy gives experience; at every level your damage grows and you pick an upgrade among the cards on offer ("Frenzy strikes +2" too; extra health only shows up now and then). The game saves by itself every 5 minutes and when you enter a cave, with no enemies nearby; from the pause menu ({menu}) you save by hand.
